note: Area 1 parts shops and the garage's repairs (GDD 8.3 to 8.5, Spec 7.4, 14.4 to 14.6). Prices are in pounds for a new Grade 1 part on a 50cc; each grade costs gradeFactor times the one below. slotBase values not given in Spec 14.4 (bottom end, shock, brakes, bodywork, wheels and tyres as one slot) are first-pass guesses to tune in testing. Frames are not sold: they come from your sponsor or the class dealer (Spec 18.9). classDealer is the shop (Bill at Moto78, Boss 30 Oct 2026) where a new class's bike is collected once its milestone championship is won: the champion's sponsor offers a free stock bike of their brand, or the rider buys a stock Grade 1 bike of any brand at the sum of its parts' prices. fitFee is the garage's bench fee for fitting a spare (provisional); parts bought in a shop are fitted there free. consumables (Boss, 28 Oct 2026) are slots that are only ever replaced: tyres can't be repaired or sold, and once they hit 0% they are broken.

shops.name: Moto78

shops.name: Tyres and wheels
